LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 COMPARATIVE AND SUPERLATIVE ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives, part of Strand 5 in Grade 7 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to make comparisons in life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify comparative and superlative adjectives from texts, in pairs,

2. search online or offline for examples of comparative and superlative adjectives,

3. construct sentences using comparative and superlative adjectives,

4. play language games featuring adjectives,

5. use a substitution table to complete sentences featuring comparative and superlative adjectives,

6. use flashcards to categorise comparative and superlative adjectives,

7. work with peers to compare various items within the environment using comparative and superlative adjectives.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify comparative and superlative adjectives from texts, in pairs,
2. search online or offline for examples of comparative and superlative adjectives,
3. construct sentences using comparative and superlative adjectives,
4. play language games featuring adjectives,
5. use a substitution table to complete sentences featuring comparative and superlative adjectives,
6. use flashcards to categorise comparative and superlative adjectives,
7. work with peers to compare various items within the environment using comparative and superlative adjectives.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Comparative and Superlative Adjectives together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: It is developed as the learner organises their learning and searches online or offline for examples of

comparative and superlative adjectives.

• Self-efficacy: It is enhanced as the learner uses flashcards to categorise adjectives into comparatives and superlatives

successfully.

Values:
Love is nurtured as the learner uses adjectives in the comparative and superlative forms to express family relations.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Self-awareness is enhanced as the learner identifies comparative and superlative adjectives from texts on family relationships.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner relates correct use of comparative and superlative forms to the editing of their written work in all learning areas

including Pre-Technical Studies.
